fix round 1: is_google_account cannot raise on null/array/scalar/nested app metadata and never returns null; AFTER ROW early return null is ignored by PostgreSQL; GoTrue CreateAccount path sets provider=google before INSERT (supabase/auth ToUserModel); helper revoked from clients; seed.sql comment accurate

fix round 2: UPDATE OF raw_app_meta_data fires on every repeat Google sign-in (GoTrue AccountExists UpdateAppMetaDataProviders, identical value) — no-op via on conflict do nothing, re-creates a deleted sunner (consistent with 'every Google account gets a sunner'; no app path deletes sunners); concurrent same-user sign-ins serialize on the auth.users row lock and the unique user_id arbiter skips without error; LinkAccount writes raw_user_meta_data before raw_app_meta_data so the Google profile feeds ALG-007; SoftDeleteUser empties app metadata so the gate returns early; raw_app_meta_data not user-writable, manual linking disabled (config.toml:181); per-sign-in cost one function call and one unique-index probe
